KEY. SRS=FBI Summary Return-A (monthly Return A rolled to a year; it is the only FBI-side lane that can record a literal ZERO months reported). Year lines: 'YY: LANE total/months_reported/tier' -- 12mo=full year, 0mo=SRS carries the agency but records zero months submitted, 'none'=no row in any lane, NoF7=fewer than 7 offense rows in that lane-year. CW=footprint ('statewide_overlap_layer'=mass smeared over the whole state; 'state_nonmunicipal_remainder'=the unincorporated remainder; 'municipal:place:XXXXXXX'=one Census place). KNOWN INGESTION ARTIFACTS, stated explicitly so you do not have to infer them:

Everything in this packet is what SURVIVED those rules.

DECIDE: this agency-year is published as a COMPLETE full year, but its total collapses against its own history and/or against same-type same-size peers. CIUS=the FBI's own published agency table (Table 8 city / Table 9 university / Table 11 state-tribal-other). SPUB=a state UCR program's published table (FL FDLE, NY DCJS, MS TOPS). LPUB=a city's own published table. Year lines: 'YY: LANE total/months_reported/tier' -- 12mo=full year, 0mo=SRS carries the agency but records zero months submitted, 'none'=no row in any lane, NoF7=fewer than 7 offense rows in that lane-year. Offense order everywhere: murder/rape/robbery/agg assault/burglary/larceny/motor vehicle theft. CW=footprint ('statewide_overlap_layer'=mass smeared over the whole state; 'state_nonmunicipal_remainder'=the unincorporated remainder; 'municipal:place:XXXXXXX'=one Census place). FBIpop=population served as the FBI records it, by year (0 means the FBI publishes no population for that ORI -- normal for special-jurisdiction and state agencies; '-' means the ORI has no row at all that year).
